# Introduction to Hypothesis Testing

## Foundations of Inference
* In research, we test hypotheses using samples to determine if observed patterns reflect true population effects.
* Parametric testing assumes specific data properties (normality, equal variance).
* Core library: **testflow** and **rstatix** (clean tidyverse-style outputs).

---

# T-Tests: Comparing Two Groups

## Parametric t-tests
* Compare mean values across two independent groups (e.g. comparing temperature between sites):
  ```r
  library(tidyverse)
  library(rstatix)
  library(testflow)
  
  # Conduct t-test
  t_res <- macroplastics |>
    t_test(macroplastics_count ~ location, var.equal = TRUE)
  ```
* Evaluates null hypothesis ($H_0: \mu_1 = \mu_2$).

---

# ANOVA: Comparing Multiple Groups

## Analysis of Variance (ANOVA)
* Compares mean values across three or more categories:
  ```r
  # Conduct one-way ANOVA
  anova_res <- macroplastics |>
    anova_test(macroplastics_count ~ location)
  ```
* If ANOVA yields significant $p$-values, perform a **post-hoc pairwise test** (Tukey HSD) to pinpoint differences:
  ```r
  # Tukey HSD post-hoc test
  post_hoc <- macroplastics |>
    tukey_hsd(macroplastics_count ~ location)
  ```
